text:
anna (devex): Hey, hitting a flakey bug in the async Python client. If a request times out and we retry, sometimes the server logs show a duplicate non-idempotent op (create). Repro is with streaming upload (aiohttp) + our automatic replay. Any ideas?

mike (py-sdk): ugh. Can you paste minimal repro? is this using client.send_with_retry(...)?

anna (devex): Yep. Rough snippet:
```py
await client.post('/v1/creates', json={'name':'x'}, timeout=3)
# using client configured with auto_replay=True
```
Behavior: on TimeoutError we re-issue same request; sync client uses buffered body but async path consumes stream early.

mike (py-sdk): Right — current async path reads the aiohttp stream into a streaming iterator and when consumed it's gone. Our sync client preserves body bytes and replays. Fix options:
- buffer the body bytes in memory for replay (bad for large uploads)
- refuse to replay if body is streaming unless user provides explicit idempotency key
- add allow_replay_for_streams flag and store to temp file
Thoughts? :thinking:

sarah (platform): From platform side prefer explicit opt-in. For uploads we should force user to set Idempotency-Key if they want retries. Otherwise default to no-replay.

julio (sre): We also need to safeguard 5xx retry window. If transient 5xx spikes, repeats amplify load. Recommend: circuit breaker + decreasing concurrency and jittered backoff. Default retrials limit 2 on 5xx, 3 on timeouts; make configurable per-route.

mike (py-sdk): Agree. Proposed API changes:
- RetryConfig TypedDict typing:
```py
class RetryConfig(TypedDict, total=False):
    max_attempts: int
    backoff_base: float
    jitter: bool
    retry_5xx: bool
    allow_stream_replay: bool
```
- AsyncClient.post(..., idempotency_key: Optional[str]=None, allow_replay: bool=False)
If body is async iterator and allow_replay False and no idempotency_key -> raise ReplayNotAllowedError

anna (devex): That sounds reasonable. For UX could we auto-surface helpful error: 'cannot replay streamed body — attach Idempotency-Key or set allow_replay'? Include link to docs.

mike (py-sdk): Will add error with docs link. Also storing stream to temp file when allow_replay True (and size limit 50MB) — fallback to memory for small bodies. Need input on default size.

sarah (platform): 50MB seems OK for most, but warn in logs. Also ensure temp files are cleaned and respect TMPDIR.

julio (sre): Also add metric for replay attempts and duplicate ops; tie into alerts if duplicate rate > X% over Y minutes.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: py-sdk/retries-fix -> staging (rev 7a9f) :rocket:

anna (devex): thanks all — happy to dogfood in sample app. will open a small PR with repro + tests.
